headline: Tottenham's first win, but Chelsea are clear favourites
summary: Tottenham beat Coventry 3-1 on Monday for their first Premier League win of the season, but they created only 0.9 expected goals — the scoreline flattered them. James Maddison and Dejan Kulusevski are back, according to Yahoo Sports, so Spurs have their main creators again. Chelsea are 4th on 13 points after a 2-0 win at Everton; Tottenham are 16th on 6. Chelsea's win chance has risen from 52.5% to 54.9% in recent days, and the market rates them about 0.73 goals stronger. The market expects 3.0 goals.
read: Chelsea are clear favourites for the London derby, rated about three-quarters of a goal better than a Tottenham side sitting 16th. Spurs' first league win of the season and the returns of Maddison and Kulusevski give them a route into the game, but the market still expects a home win and roughly three goals.

facts.fact: Chelsea are clear favourites for the London derby at 54.9% to win, more than double Tottenham's 22.5%.
facts.meaning: The market rates Chelsea comfortably the better side at Stamford Bridge, though the draw is a live 22.7%.

facts.fact: Tottenham beat Coventry City 3-1 on Monday, their first Premier League win of the season.
facts.meaning: Spurs arrive off a win rather than a crisis, and with Maddison, Marmoush and Ben Davies all scoring.

facts.fact: James Maddison and Dejan Kulusevski both returned from injury and featured in Tottenham's 3-1 win over Coventry.
facts.meaning: Two of Spurs' main creators are back available for the derby, which is why their attacking threat is bigger than a 6-point start suggests.

facts.fact: Chelsea won 2-0 away at Everton on 17 October.
facts.meaning: They come into the derby off a controlled away win, with seven days between matches.

facts.fact: Chelsea's win chance has risen from 52.5% to 54.9% in recent days.
facts.meaning: The home side has been strengthened since the weekend, with Tottenham's chance slipping the other way.

facts.fact: Sports Mole reports Tottenham's injury and suspension list for the Chelsea match includes Pedro Porro, Savio and Lucas Bergvall.
facts.meaning: Spurs may be without regular options at right-back and in midfield, thinning the squad that has to cover the derby.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line has moved from -0.63 to -0.73, with Chelsea now rated about three-quarters of a goal better.
Chelsea have had seven days since their last match; Tottenham played on Monday and have five.
facts.meaning: Chelsea go into a high-tempo derby with two extra days of recovery.

sources.fact: Tottenham claimed their first Premier League win of the season by beating Coventry City 3-1, with James Maddison, Omar Marmoush and Ben Davies scoring.
James Maddison and Dejan Kulusevski both returned from injury and featured in Tottenham's 3-1 win over Coventry City.
Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi said after the Coventry win that his side must keep their feet on the ground because the performance was good but they can get better.
Roberto De Zerbi confirmed that two Tottenham players will be available for Saturday's derby at Chelsea despite injury scares, though Spurs have an extensive injury list.
Sports Mole reports that Tottenham's injury and suspension list ahead of the Chelsea match includes Pedro Porro, Savio and Lucas Bergvall, with return dates listed.
Dejan Kulusevski said he had warned his closest family that his return to football might not work out before he came back from injury against Coventry.
Chelsea won 2-0 away at Everton in the Premier League in their most recent match.
Xabi Alonso is Chelsea's head coach and made one change to the starting XI for the Premier League fixture away to Everton.
